properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party X25519 (ref10) key agreement, exposed as crypto_scalarmult; underlies crypto_box (curve25519xsalsa20poly1305) and crypto_kx (reported separately — the wrapper is regex-blind). Quantum-vulnerable ECDH and this library's primary harvest-now-decrypt-later surface: every crypto_box/crypto_kx exchange is passively recordable and retroactively breakable. Migration path is in-tree: ML-KEM-768 (crypto_kem/mlkem768) and the X-Wing hybrid (crypto_kem/xwing, X25519+ML-KEM-768). Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party Keccak/SHAKE-256 XOF (crypto_core/keccak1600 incl. ARM-SHA3 backend); powers ML-KEM-768 internally (crypto_kem/mlkem768/ref/kem_mlkem768_ref.c) and is exported as crypto_xof_shake256 in this tree. Symmetric, Grover-only; no PQ migration needed. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party BLAKE2b (crypto_generichash, ref + SSE backends); also the session-key KDF in crypto_kx (crypto_generichash over the X25519 shared secret) and the PRF of crypto_kdf (kdf_blake2b derive_from_key with subkey_id/context) and Argon2's internal mixing. Symmetric, Grover-only. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3/Keccak-1600 as shipped in libsodium: the keccak1600 permutation core in three variants (portable keccak1600.c, reference ref/keccak1600_ref.c, and the ARM SHA3-instruction keccak1600_armsha3.c), the crypto_hash_sha3 API, and the SHAKE128/SHAKE256 XOFs built on the same core (crypto_xof). Used internally by ML-KEM-768 (its SHA3/SHAKE primitives) and exported as public hash/XOF APIs, as the wasm export lists in dist-build/emscripten.sh show. Symmetric sponge — PQ-safe, no Shor exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: libsodium's ML-KEM-768 implementation (FIPS 203), exposed as the crypto_kem_mlkem768 API: keypair/seed_keypair/enc/dec wrappers in kem_mlkem768.c over the reference implementation in crypto_kem/mlkem768/ref, plus the wasm export lists in dist-build/emscripten.sh that ship it in the JS builds. This is the library's post-quantum KEM — the PQ-safe counterpart consumers would use to replace X25519/ECDH key agreement. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party HMAC family: crypto_auth defaults to HMAC-SHA-512-256, plus HMAC-SHA-256 and HMAC-SHA-512; MAC verification routes through constant-time crypto_verify_16 (verified at auth_hmacsha256.c:106 / auth_hmacsha512_verify paths). Symmetric, Grover-only. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: libsodium's Argon2id implementation (RFC 9106), the library's default password hashing (crypto_pwhash / crypto_pwhash_str API): argon2id_hash_encoded / argon2id_hash_raw / argon2id_verify in crypto_pwhash/argon2, PHC-string encoding and parsing ("$argon2id$v=..." in argon2-encoding.c), plus the wasm build help/export mentions in dist-build/emscripten.sh. Memory-hard KDF — the recommended modern password hashing choice; not quantum-relevant.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto_aead_aes256gcm: AES-256-GCM with hardware-only backends (AES-NI on x86, ARMv8 crypto), gated by crypto_aead_aes256gcm_is_available; sites include the packaging/dotnet-core bindings test and the WASM export surface. Key size is 256 bits (KEYBYTES 32) — the object's "graded at AES-128 floor" caveat is resolved by the companion AES-256 object. Same logical asset as ALG-12f61078. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 as shipped and used inside libsodium itself: the crypto_hash_sha256 implementation (hash_sha256_cp.c), HMAC-SHA256 (crypto_auth_hmacsha256) serving the auth API, scrypt's PBKDF2 PRF, the HKDF-SHA256 KDF (crypto_kdf/hkdf), and Ed25519/Ristretto hash-to-curve (core_h2c). The test/default sites are the library's own test suite exercising the same APIs. Symmetric primitive — no Shor exposure; only Grover's quadratic speedup applies.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 implemented as escrypt_PBKDF2_SHA256 in libsodium, used solely as the internal PRF of the scrypt KDF (crypto_pwhash_scryptsalsa208sha256). Called only with c=1, which RFC 7914 mandates for scrypt's two internal derivation steps; not exposed as a standalone password-hashing API. The two sibling objects that read these same sites as a 'weak password hash' / 'PBKDF2 below OWASP minimum' were rejected as false matches; this object is the accurate record of the primitive's presence
